_comment: Tuning set for the fusion weights of semantic search (vector search fused with keyword search). Written by hand, independently of the held-out set, as reworded questions in a reader's words rather than the docs' own. About a third share no meaningful word with the target page's title or URL, a third share some words and a third are close to the docs' wording. Use it only to tune weights. It's never used to report a decision, which is measured on the held-out set. 'expect' lists URL fragments of the pages that genuinely answer the query; a result is a hit when any fragment is a substring of its URL.
